briefdescription.para: Converts a matrix to another color space.

detaileddescription.para: Grayscale conversion uses the ITU-R BT.601 luminance coefficients.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have same size as src and the channel count required by code.

memberdef.argsstring: (const cvl_Mat *src, cvl_Mat *dst, cvl_depth_t ddepth, double alpha, double beta)
memberdef.name: cvl_cvt_depth

briefdescription.para: Converts a matrix to another type with scaling.

detaileddescription.para: Effectively: dst(x, y) = saturate_cast<ddepth>(alpha * src(x, y) + beta)

parameterdescription.para: Output matrix. Must have the same dimensions and number of channels as src.
Destination depth - type to convert to. See cvl_depth_t.
Multiplicative scale factor (1.0 for no change).

memberdef.name: cvl_threshold

briefdescription.para: Applies a fixed-level threshold to each element.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum output value used by binary thresholding.

memberdef.argsstring: (const cvl_Mat *src, cvl_Mat *dst, float angle, cvl_interp_t interp)
memberdef.name: cvl_rotate

briefdescription.para: Rotates a matrix clockwise around its center.

detaileddescription.para: The dimensions of dst determine the output region. Source coordinates outside the input matrix are left unchanged in the destination matrix.
Orthogonal rotations use direct pixel rearrangement. Other angles use the specified interpolation method.

briefdescription.para: Inverts matrix values relative to a specified maximum.

detaileddescription.para: Each element's value becomes maxval - value. Values are processed independently for each channel.

briefdescription.para: Applies morphological dilation to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces each element with the maximum value within its square neighborhood.
Border pixels are handled by replicating the nearest edge pixel.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square structuring element.

briefdescription.para: Applies morphological erosion to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces each element with the minimum value within its square neighborhood.
Border pixels are handled by replicating the nearest edge pixel.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square structuring element.

briefdescription.para: Applies morphological opening to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: Performs erosion followed by dilation using the same square structuring element.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square structuring element.

briefdescription.para: Applies morphological closing to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: Performs dilation followed by erosion using the same square structuring element.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square structuring element.

memberdef.argsstring: (const cvl_Mat *src, cvl_Mat *dst, int r, int c)
memberdef.name: cvl_crop

briefdescription.para: Copies a rectangular region of interest into a destination matrix.

detaileddescription.para: The region begins at (r, c) in the source matrix and has the dimensions of dst.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix defining the output dimensions.
Starting row in the source matrix.
Starting column in the source matrix.

briefdescription.para: Resizes a matrix using the specified interpolation method.

detaileddescription.para: The destination matrix determines the output dimensions. Interpolation is performed independently for each channel.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix defining the output dimensions.

briefdescription.para: Labels connected foreground components in a binary image.

detaileddescription.para: WHITE pixels are treated as background; all other pixels are treated as foreground.
Labels are assigned positive integer values, with zero reserved for background pixels.

parameterdescription.para: Single-channel CVL_32S destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.

briefdescription.para: Colors connected components that meet a minimum size.

detaileddescription.para: Calculates the size of each labeled component and assigns a unique color to components containing at least thresh pixels. Components smaller than the threshold are unchanged.

simplesect.para: Number of components meeting the minimum size.

briefdescription.para: Applies a two-dimensional correlation operation.

detaileddescription.para: The kernel is not flipped. Values outside the source matrix are treated as zero (constant-zero padding).
The output has the same dimensions, depth, and number of channels as the source matrix.

briefdescription.para: Applies a two-dimensional convolution operation.

detaileddescription.para: Convolves the source matrix with the specified kernel. Convolution flips the kernel by 180-degrees and then applies correlation.
Values outside the source matrix are treated as zero (constant-zero padding).

briefdescription.para: Applies a separable two-dimensional convolution.

detaileddescription.para: First convolves each row using the horizontal kernel, then convolves each column of the intermediate result using the vertical kernel.
This operation is useful when a two-dimensional filter can be represented as the product of two one-dimensional kernels.

memberdef.argsstring: (const cvl_Mat *src, cvl_Mat *dst, int ksize, bool normalize)
memberdef.name: cvl_blur_box

briefdescription.para: Applies box filtering using a uniform square kernel.

detaileddescription.para: Each output element is calculated from the sum of its neighborhood values. If normalize is true, the kernel weights are scaled by 1/(ksize * ksize), producing a mean filter.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square kernel.
Whether to normalize the kernel weights.

briefdescription.para: Applies a normalized box filter (mean blur).

detaileddescription.para: Each output element is the average of the values within its square neighborhood.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square kernel.

memberdef.argsstring: (const cvl_Mat *src, cvl_Mat *dst, int ksize, double sigma)
memberdef.name: cvl_blur_gauss

briefdescription.para: Applies Gaussian blur to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: If ksize is zero or negative, the kernel size is derived from sigma. If sigma is zero or negative, the standard deviation is derived from ksize.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix containing the blurred result.
Gaussian kernel width and height. Must be positive when sigma is not specified.
Standard deviation of the Gaussian distribution. Must be positive when ksize is not specified.

briefdescription.para: Applies median filtering to a matrix.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces each element with the median value of its square neighborhood. Border pixels are handled by replicating the nearest edge pixel.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix. Must have the same dimensions as src.
Width and height of the square neighborhood, must be odd.

briefdescription.para: Computes horizontal and vertical Sobel derivatives.

detaileddescription.para: Applies the 3x3 Sobel operators to a single-channel source matrix to estimate intensity gradients in the horizontal and vertical directions.
Both output matrices contain signed gradient values represented using CVL_FLOAT64.

parameterdescription.para: Destination matrix for horizontal gradients. Must be single-channel CVL_FLOAT64.
Destination matrix for vertical gradients. Must be single-channel CVL_FLOAT64.

briefdescription.para: Computes Sobel gradient magnitude.

detaileddescription.para: Calculates horizontal and vertical Sobel derivatives and combines them using the Euclidean magnitude:
magnitude = sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy).

parameterdescription.para: Single-channel destination matrix containing gradient magnitudes.

briefdescription.para: Converts a matrix to another color space and returns the result.

detaileddescription.para: Grayscale conversion uses the ITU-R BT.601 luminance coefficients.

simplesect.para: Newly allocated matrix containing the converted image.

briefdescription.para: Image processing operations.

detaileddescription.para: Provides functions for common image processing tasks, including:

listitem.para: Color and type conversion: color-space conversion, depth conversion, thresholding.
Morphological Transformations: dilation, erosion, opening, closing.
Connected Component Analysis: labeling and visualization.
Filtering and Convolution: correlation, convolution, box filtering, Gaussian blur, median blur.
Edge Detection: Sobel derivatives and gradient magnitudes.
